title: fix(app-shell): Studio names a draft-only item by its `_drafts` label, machine name second (objectui#11862 remainder)
body:
Fixes #11862 (the remainder after PR #11906, which landed as `Refs #11862`)
Clause-②: no

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (claim comment `6183259744`). Implementing session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`.

## What changed

Since objectstack `c512c255c5` (objectstack#22200, installed here as `@objectstack/*` `18.0.0-next.1`), each `GET /meta/_drafts` row carries the draft body's own label, or `null`. Studio now reads that label off the row, as the seat ruling `6053526025` (question 1, A at the producer) asked. No item is read to find its label. The label leads, and the machine name follows as smaller monospace text. A row with no label shows its name alone, as before.

- **Access, the permission-set list** (`AccessPillar` in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`): a draft-only set took `label: name`. It now takes the `_drafts` row's label, resolved in the designer locale.
- **Automations, the flow list** (`packageSurfaces.ts`, the draft merge behind `loadPackageSurfaces` / `loadPackageLessSurfaces`): a draft-only row took the machine name as its label. It now takes the row's label. Both loaders take the designer `locale` for a locale-map label.
- **Interfaces, the nav editor:**
  - **The resolver** (`hooks/useNavTargetLabel.ts`): a label-less nav entry inherits its target's current label from the console's metadata. A draft-only object or dashboard is in no published list, so the entry read as its machine name in the rail, on the edit-mode cards and in the inspector's Label placeholder. The resolver gains a last rung, `DraftTargetLabels`. The surface provides the `_drafts` rows it already reads for its Changes count, so no request is added. The rung is asked only when the metadata has no label, so a published label still wins. A stored plural type spelling is folded with `canonicalMetaUrlType`. With no provider the list is empty and the hook answers as before, which is the console's case.
  - **The target pickers** (`usePackageNavTargets`): the page, dashboard and report pickers now keep a draft row's label, so they offer a draft-only item as `Label (name)`, the same as a published one.
- **The Changes list** (`preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx`, on top of PR #12400's `?member=` and PR #11916's added/changed/removed split): each row leads with the row's label, in the console language, and shows the name beneath it in monospace. A row with no label keeps the name alone, in monospace. The label reaches the panel through `fetchPendingDrafts` (`preview/usePendingDrafts.ts`), which now keeps `label` when it is served. It used to drop it.

Display only: nothing saved changes, and no label is written.

## The remainder rows, re-measured on `main` `2fc31ea94a` before any change

Each row has a pin. Every pin was run against unmodified `main` first. Reading: 16 failed, 18 passed (34), and every control passed.

- **(a) The permission-set list shows `qa_readers`:** still failing. `AccessPillar` set a draft row's label to its name.
- **(b) Draft-only items in the rails and the nav editor:** still failing.
  - The Access rail, as in (a).
  - The flow rail took `label: name`.
  - The nav editor's resolver had no draft source, so a label-less entry read as its machine name.
  - The nav target pickers dropped the draft row's label.
  - The Data rail's draft-only objects already read their labels, through objectui#11843's draft-overlaid list read. That row already works and was not rebuilt. Only its now-stale comment sentence ("a draft header carries no label") is corrected.
- **(c) The Changes list:** still failing. Each row rendered `entry.name` in monospace, and `fetchPendingDrafts` dropped `label`.
- **(d) The Lookup inspector's *Related object* and *Display field*:** already landed on `main`, after the re-measure. PR #12324 (`b64fda3f60`, objectui#12303, row 6) made `InspectorComboField` and `ObjectPicker` read the label first. Its pin `lookupLabelFirst-12303.test.tsx` gives 7 passed on this branch. Reported, not rebuilt.

## Mechanism assumptions, measured

- **A2, the `_drafts` row shape:** read from the installed `@objectstack/spec` `18.0.0-next.1` type, `ListDraftsResponseSchema`: `drafts[].label` is `string | I18nLabel map | null`, and its doc says a locale map is resolved by the reader. Every consumer here resolves it with the spec's `resolveI18nLabel`. `@object-ui/data-objectstack`'s `MetadataDraftHeader` does not declare `label` (or `member`), so the two Studio reads that go through `client.listDrafts` type the row locally (see the Acceptance notes).
- **A3, the surfaces:** confirmed for the Access rail and `DraftChangesPanel.tsx`. The lookup inspector is `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`, through the shared `ObjectPicker` and `InspectorComboField` (row d). The nav editor is `NavTree`, `AppNavCanvas` and `StudioNavItemInspector`, which all ask `useNavTargetLabel`.
- **A4:** this work sits on top of PR #12400 and PR #11916. Both are on the base, and `member` handling is untouched.

## File surface

Expected and touched: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `DraftChangesPanel.tsx`, their tests and one changeset. Three more files are the seams the named rows read through, inside `@object-ui/app-shell`:

- `preview/usePendingDrafts.ts`: the one `_drafts` row parser. It dropped `label`, so the Changes list could not read the row's label without it.
- `views/studio-design/packageSurfaces.ts`: the flow rail's draft merge, which the release `6054565160` counts among "the rails".
- `hooks/useNavTargetLabel.ts`: the label resolver every nav-editor view asks. The new context is a module export, not exported from the package entry.

`AppNavCanvas.tsx` needed no edit: it asks the same resolver, inside the provider.

**Clause-② re-read:** nothing is added to the package entry. There is no new package-root export, published prop, type member on a published type, accepted input or language-pack key. The new names are module-internal: `DraftTargetLabels` / `DraftTargetLabel` in `hooks/useNavTargetLabel.ts`, an optional `locale` parameter on the two `packageSurfaces` loaders, and `label` on the module-internal `PendingDraftEntry` and `DraftChangeEntry`. `no` holds.

**One deviation from the suggested route:** the Changes list's UPDATE row leads with the `_drafts` row's label, as the NEW row does, not with the published label. The ruling's reason for A was that "each consumer stops deciding on its own which label wins". The `_drafts` label is the one publishing makes live, and it needs no change to the published-list read. When a draft renames an item, the drill-in already lists `label` among the changed keys.

## Tests

The final head is the commit this PR opens on. Every run went through the shared verify lock, and its `VERDICT` line is quoted.

- **New and updated pins** (35 tests across 4 files, all passing, `VERDICT command-exit 0`):
  - `StudioDesignSurface.accessRailLabels-11862.test.tsx`: a draft-only set with a label, a locale-map label, and a `null`-label control. It also checks that the draft-only set is never read for its label.
  - `packageSurfaces.test.ts`: the flow rail's draft label, a locale map in `zh-CN` and `en-US`, a `null` or blank control, published wins, and the package-less loader.
  - `StudioDesignSurface.navDraftLabels-11862.test.tsx`, through the whole surface: the rail for an object and a dashboard, a `null` control, and the edit-mode cards. Through the resolver: published wins, a plural type folds, another type does not match, and with no provider nothing changes. Also the inspector's placeholder and the dashboard picker, with a `null` control.
  - `DraftChangesPanel.labelFirst-11862.test.tsx`: a NEW row, an UPDATE row, a locale map, a `null` control, and no read by name of the permission or page rows.
- **Wider suites** (all passing):
  - `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.*`: 76 files, 511 tests.
  - The other studio-design files plus the console's `StudioRoute*`: 98 files, 803 tests.
  - `studio-design/__tests__/`: 5 files, 20 tests.
  - `preview/`, `hooks/`, `metadata-admin/previews/`, `console/ai/`, `console/home/` and the two `views/__tests__` nav-label files: 267 files, 2546 tests.
- **Ablations** were run with the fix committed, through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode. The predicted counts were written down before each run, and every observed count matched. Each anchor went from 1 hit to 0, and each restore was proven: the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

  | Leg | Mutation | Pin | Result |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | A1 | The Changes row's `labelText` set to `''` | `DraftChangesPanel.labelFirst-11862` | 3 failed, 2 passed |
  | A2 | The Access draft row back to `label: name` | `accessRailLabels-11862` | 2 failed, 3 passed |
  | A3 | The resolver's object draft rung removed | `navDraftLabels-11862` | 5 failed, 6 passed |
  | A4 | The nav picker's draft row label dropped | `navDraftLabels-11862` | 1 failed, 10 passed |
  | A5 | The flow merge back to `label: name` | `packageSurfaces` | 3 failed, 11 passed |

  `ablation-dist-preflight` does not apply: every pin imports its subject by relative source path.

## Gates (local subset; CI runs the full farm)

- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`: exit 0, 28 of 28 tasks.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. The script echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, and `--listFilesOnly` shows the 4 pin files in the test program.
- `eslint` on the 9 touched `.ts` / `.tsx` files: exit 0, with 0 errors. Warnings per file equal the base blobs': `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 13 and 13, `DraftChangesPanel.tsx` 2 and 2, `usePendingDrafts.ts` 1 and 1, and 0 in the rest.
- These gates exited 0:
  - `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new) and `check:spec-symbols`;
  - `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` and `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`;
  - `check:i18n-keys`;
  - `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape` and `check:test-path-roots`;
  - `check:phantom-deps` and `check:unreferenced-sources`.
- `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 10 paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- No string was added, so the i18n parity gates have nothing new to read. `check:eager-closure` needs a console build, which CI does.

## Acceptance notes (noted, not filed)

- `@object-ui/data-objectstack`'s `MetadataDraftHeader` lags `ListDraftsResponseSchema`: it has no `label` and no `member`. The Studio reads that go through `client.listDrafts` therefore type the served row locally. Deriving the header from the spec type would end that. This is type drift with no failing reader. No owner.
- The Data rail's draft-only object labels still come from objectui#11843's draft-overlaid list read. That read could now give way to the `_drafts` label. It was left in place because the row already works. No owner.
- The Changes list's group heading shows the raw metadata type (`permission · 1`). The panel stays off the metadata-admin string table on purpose, because it sits on the console's eager graph. Observation only.
